Chapter 5: Embracing Uncertainty—Building a Life Around What Matters Most
Let’s talk about what it really means to step into the world of “Must.” It’s not just about chasing dreams—it’s about letting go of the comfort that comes from certainty.
Think about it: those old markers of success like job titles, impressive salaries, or seeking approval from others—they stop feeling as solid as they once did. Instead, there’s this brand new kind of security that comes from inside you. It’s the confidence you get when you’re living in line with your own values, honoring what feels true, and shaping your life around what matters most.
Picture someone leaving a high-powered job to follow their passion for teaching. The paychecks are smaller, the days are longer, and the road ahead is anything but clear.
But something shifts. There’s a deeper sense of purpose—a reason that makes every challenge feel worthwhile. Each day opens up new chances to connect, inspire, and really make a difference in the lives of others.
Now, most of us expect the journey toward our “Must”—that thing we feel called to do—to be this neat, straight line, right? From point A to point B, no detours. But honestly, it’s almost never like that. It’s often unpredictable.
There’ll be moments when everything feels crystal clear, and then—suddenly—you hit a patch of confusion or doubt. You’ll experience breakthroughs, setbacks, bursts of joy, and times when you question everything. It’s more like moving in a spiral than a straight line, with each loop bringing fresh insights and new opportunities.
So, how do you actually deal with all that uncertainty? One powerful way is to focus on small, consistent actions.
Take the person who wanted to write a novel. They didn’t wait for the perfect idea or the ideal setup. They just showed up and wrote a little bit every day, even on days when it felt pointless or hard. Eventually, those pages stacked up, and the story started to come alive. The real reward? Simply showing up for yourself, day after day.
Here’s something else to remember: let go of comparison. It’s so easy to look around and think everyone else has it all figured out, isn’t it? But the truth is, every journey is unique.
What works for someone else might not be right for you. The only way to find real fulfillment is to stay true to your own path, trust the process, and celebrate every bit of progress—no matter how small.
Building a life around your “Must” isn’t about crossing a finish line or hitting one specific goal. It’s about creating a way of living that feels authentic, meaningful, and truly alive. It means making choices that reflect who you really are—not just who others expect you to be.
And remember, this journey doesn’t really end. There will always be new crossroads, new choices, and new chances to pick between “Should” and “Must.” The key is to keep listening to yourself, keep experimenting, and keep moving forward—one step at a time.
Because over time, the world of “Must” stops being a far-off dream. It starts to become your everyday reality.
